chunks: And with this chain of narration, from 'Amir ibn Kathir, from Abu Numayr, who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'Our Wilayah (guardianship) was presented to the people of the cities, but none accepted it as the people of Kufa did. This is because the grave of Ali (peace be upon him) is there, and I have the Zulfah (closeness) to another grave, meaning the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him). There is no one who comes to it, prays two or four rak'at near it, and then asks Allah for his need, except that He fulfills it for him. And surely, a thousand angels surround it every day.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of the grave of Imam Husain (a.s.) in Kufa according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to emphasize Kufa's spiritual primacy, linking the acceptance of Wilayah to the physical proximity of Imam Ali’s grave and the unique 'Zulfah' (closeness) to Imam Husayn. It underscores the efficacy of devotional acts at these sites, promising the fulfillment of needs through the intercession of a thousand angels who attend the grave daily, reflecting the Shia belief in the tangible spiritual presence of the Imams.
